name: aipathshala-mobile
description: Capacitor shell wrapping the AI Pathshala PWA for iOS + Android.

scripts.build:prod: npm run configure:prod && npm run check:prod && cap sync
scripts.ios:run: npm run configure && cap run ios
scripts.android:run: npm run configure && cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run configure:prod && npm run check:prod && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:archive: npm run configure:prod && npm run check:prod && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App archive
scripts.publish:android: npm run configure:prod && npm run check:prod && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && echo 'Upload android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab to Play Console'
scripts.publish:ios: echo 'Run: npm run configure:prod && npm run check:prod && npx cap open ios → Xcode → Product → Archive → Distribute App → App Store Connect'
